title: [Master] Bug 645040: Expense Agent: BC Approval Workflow - Improve error message when Approval User Setup is missing
summary: Expense approval workflow now shows a clear, actionable error message when the current user lacks a User Setup record, with a link to open the configuration page.
key_points: New internal helper GetCurrentUserSetupForApproval replaces the generic missing-record platform error
Error message asks the user to configure their User Setup because the expense approval workflow is enabled
Error includes an action to open the Approval User Setup page, shown only with read permission on User Setup
Used on the Expense Report, Expense Report List, Expense Reports, Manager Expense Report and Manager Expense Reports pages and the Expense Report Header table
Tests added for the missing User Setup scenario
